BlackBerry Dynamics SDK for iOS Development Guide
Official BlackBerry Dynamics iOS SDK Swift Package
provenanceSources.notes: Tag 15.0.0 ships SDK build 15.0.8513.67; required products BlackBerryDynamics + GSEProvider

provenanceSources.description: Installed SDK headers in Pods/BlackBerryDynamics/ after pod install, SPM package checkout after resolution, or .xcframework headers

inventedNames.description: Names that do NOT exist in the Dynamics iOS SDK. Any shippable guidance containing these names is incorrect and must be rejected.

rows.nativeApi: App launches and immediately accesses sensitive data
rows.dynamicsReplacement: GDiOS.sharedInstance().authorize(_:)
rows.limitations: Authorize must succeed before accessing any secure container. Post-authorization callback is the safe entry point.
rows.reportRequirements: Report must note authorization pattern replaced if app lifecycle was modified.

rows.dynamicsReplacement: GDiOSDelegate protocol + GDiOS.sharedInstance().authorize(_:) call in didFinishLaunching
rows.limitations: GDiOSDelegate exposes handleEvent: only. Dispatch app-owned helper methods (for example onAuthorized/onNotAuthorized) from handleEvent: based on GDAppEvent type.
rows.reportRequirements: Coverage area 'authorization' must be 'migrated' or 'partial'.

rows.dynamicsReplacement: GDFileManager
rows.limitations: Keep existing app path-building logic; replace API surface with GDFileManager for secure-container interception.
rows.reportRequirements: Report apisReplaced entry must reference this row ID.

rows.dynamicsReplacement: GDFileHandle
GDCReadStream / GDCWriteStream
Write through GDFileManager / GDFileHandle / GDCWriteStream
rows.limitations: Do not stage sensitive plaintext to unmanaged temp paths during migration.
rows.reportRequirements: Report must describe secure writer migration path for sensitive call sites.

rows.nativeApi: Data(contentsOf:) / String(contentsOf:) / local file URL readers of sensitive payloads
rows.dynamicsReplacement: Read through GDFileManager / GDFileHandle / GDCReadStream from secure container
rows.limitations: Writer replacement is insufficient if downstream readers still consume unmanaged local files.
rows.reportRequirements: Report should include downstream reader/follow-on closure notes.

rows.dynamicsReplacement: Secure container file storage (GDFileManager/GDFileHandle) with one-time migration
rows.limitations: Non-sensitive preferences can remain in UserDefaults; sensitive keys must be decisioned per call site.
rows.reportRequirements: Report should include sensitive UserDefaults migration decisions and evidence.

rows.nativeApi: Keychain APIs and wrappers (SecItem*, KeychainAccess, SwiftKeychainWrapper)
rows.dynamicsReplacement: Policy-driven outcome per call site (retain, migrate, or block) with explicit rationale
rows.limitations: Not globally safe or forbidden; decision must reflect data class, lifecycle, and threat model.
rows.reportRequirements: Report should include keychain policy decisions and evidence.

rows.nativeApi: Local cryptography for at-rest data (CryptoKit/CommonCrypto/SQLCipher helper paths)
rows.dynamicsReplacement: Evidence-based retain/remove decision after secure-storage migration
rows.limitations: Do not remove local crypto without proving redundancy/conflict for the specific path.
rows.reportRequirements: Report should capture local-crypto decision rationale per sensitive path.

rows.dynamicsReplacement: sqlite3enc_open / sqlite3enc_open_v2
rows.limitations: DB path must resolve inside the secure container. Call-site signatures mirror sqlite3, but ALL sqlite3_* symbols used with an encrypted handle must resolve from Dynamics SQLite — never system libsqlite3. Open-only bridges are insufficient.
rows.reportRequirements: Report apisReplaced entry must reference this row ID.

rows.dynamicsReplacement: Direct sqlite3enc_* migration OR retain FMDB with full iOS Dynamics SQLite linkage (product dep + header redirect)
rows.limitations: FMDB calls sqlite3_open internally. Open-only sqlite3enc hooks while exec/prepare still use system libsqlite3 cause SIGSEGV. Required: iOS BlackBerryDynamics link + GD_C sqlite3/sqlite3enc headers for the FMDB module; macOS may keep system SQLite.
rows.reportRequirements: Report must describe wrapper migration strategy (replace vs full-linkage) and confirm iOS does not link system libsqlite3 for the SQL module.

rows.dynamicsReplacement: No first-party GRDB replacement; migrate to sqlite3enc_* or block explicitly
rows.limitations: Unsupported as-is for secureSql closure without explicit redesign.
rows.reportRequirements: Report must not mark GRDB surfaces as migrated without secure replacement evidence.

rows.dynamicsReplacement: Rewrite to sqlite3enc_* C API and remove SQLite.swift dependency
rows.limitations: SQLite.swift uses sqlite3_open internally and is incompatible as-is.
rows.reportRequirements: Report should include dependency removal and migration evidence.

rows.dynamicsReplacement: Evidence-based migration to sqlite3enc_* with one-time data transfer
rows.limitations: Do not remove SQLCipher/local crypto unless redundancy is proven for target data paths.
rows.reportRequirements: Report should include SQLCipher removal/retention rationale and migration status.

rows.nativeApi: NSPersistentStoreCoordinator (standard store types for sensitive data)
rows.dynamicsReplacement: GDPersistentStoreCoordinator with GDEncryptedBinaryStoreType or GDEncryptedIncrementalStoreType
rows.limitations: Requires stack refactor. NSPersistentContainer subclass approach is NOT the supported surface — use GDPersistentStoreCoordinator directly.
rows.reportRequirements: Coverage area 'secureCoreData' must be reported.

rows.dynamicsReplacement: No direct Dynamics replacement; explicit blocked redesign to Core Data + GDPersistentStoreCoordinator
rows.limitations: Unsupported for secure-container migration as-is; must not be silently preserved.
rows.reportRequirements: Report must include explicit SwiftData blocker/redesign status.

rows.dynamicsReplacement: URLSession auto-routed post-authorization via GDURLLoadingSystem enablement — no API replacement needed
rows.limitations: Routing applies only after successful authorization. There is NO GDURLSession class — URLSession is used directly.
rows.reportRequirements: If URLSession traffic is left as-is, report must note 'auto-routed post-authorization' treatment.

rows.dynamicsReplacement: GDSocket
Compatibility decision against GDURLProtocol routing (allow or block with rationale)
rows.limitations: Unknown or conflicting custom protocol paths must not be marked migrated.
rows.reportRequirements: Report should include custom protocol decision evidence.

rows.dynamicsReplacement: Explicit pinning/trust compatibility decision with enterprise routing
rows.limitations: Unknown pinning/trust behavior is not closure; conflict paths require blocker/manual decision.
rows.reportRequirements: Report should include pinning/trust decision outcomes.

rows.nativeApi: Background URLSession secure work requiring autonomous authorization
rows.dynamicsReplacement: Classify as foreground-deferrable or explicit G12-dependent blocker
rows.limitations: Tranche 4 does not implement Background Authorize; autonomous secure background flows must not be marked complete.
rows.reportRequirements: Report should include background-session G12 dependency status when present.

rows.dynamicsReplacement: WKWebView+GDNET category or GDURLLoadingSystem.supportWKWebView enablement
rows.limitations: Feature parity depends on web feature usage. Some WKWebView features (WKDownload, etc.) are unsupported.
rows.reportRequirements: Coverage area 'webview' must be reported if WKWebView is used.

rows.nativeApi: WKWebView local file rendering (`loadFileURL`) for protected container content
rows.dynamicsReplacement: Load managed content via secure-container reads + `loadHTMLString`/safe routing, or block unmanaged paths
rows.limitations: Protected unmanaged local-file rendering must not remain active.
rows.reportRequirements: Report should include local managed/unmanaged content classification.

rows.dynamicsReplacement: Explicit reviewed decision for scheme/pool/store behavior or blocker when safety is unproven
rows.limitations: Unreviewed custom scheme/process/data-store arrangements are not migration closure.
rows.reportRequirements: Report should include custom scheme/process/data-store decisions.

rows.nativeApi: Unsupported/high-risk web surfaces (`WKDownload`, `WKFindConfiguration`, non-page `WKContentWorld`, `removeAllUserScripts()`, `SFSafariViewController` enterprise flows)
rows.dynamicsReplacement: Disable/replace unsupported paths or block with rationale
rows.limitations: Active unsupported features must not be reported as migrated.
rows.reportRequirements: Report should include unsupported WK feature blockers and decision evidence.

rows.dynamicsReplacement: GDNativePasteboardAccess.performAction(onNativePasteboard:)
rows.limitations: Access is granted only within the closure passed to performAction(onNativePasteboard:). There are NO open()/close() methods on this class.
rows.reportRequirements: Coverage area 'dlpPasteboard' must be reported if UIPasteboard flows exist.

rows.nativeApi: External data movement surfaces (share sheet, document picker, document interaction, custom URL/universal-link payload handoff, Files/iCloud/CloudKit, Photos, AirDrop, drag/drop, Quick Look, file providers)
rows.dynamicsReplacement: Direction-aware closure: secure inbound copy, managed AppKinetics migration, or explicit blocked/manual evidence for protected outbound unmanaged export
rows.limitations: In-memory transfer alone is not policy compliance for unmanaged outbound destinations; plaintext unmanaged staging must not remain active.
rows.reportRequirements: Report must include directional taxonomy and outbound approval/blocker status for protected payload paths.

rows.nativeApi: UIActivityViewController / open share sheet for enterprise flows
rows.dynamicsReplacement: GDService + GDServiceClient (AppKinetics)
rows.limitations: AppKinetics pairing and service registration are required. Do not invent generic services when no provider/consumer contract exists.
rows.reportRequirements: Coverage area 'icc' must be reported if ICC flows exist.

rows.nativeApi: Custom configuration channels (UserDefaults, plist, remote config)
rows.dynamicsReplacement: GDiOS.sharedInstance().getApplicationConfig() / UEM app policy
rows.limitations: Policy keys must be registered in UEM. Reads that control protected behavior must be post-auth, with update-event handling and unmanaged cache removal.
rows.reportRequirements: Coverage area 'policyManagement' must include timing, update, cache, and default-handling evidence.

rows.nativeApi: Policy update notifications/events (`GDAppEventPolicyUpdate`, `GDPolicyUpdateNotification`) ignored or not wired
rows.dynamicsReplacement: Handle policy update events and re-evaluate policy-driven feature decisions
rows.limitations: Policy changes affecting DLP/export/ICC must not rely on stale cached values.
rows.reportRequirements: Report should include policy update handling and cache invalidation status.

rows.nativeApi: APNs direct push (for enterprise server-to-app signaling)
rows.dynamicsReplacement: GDPushChannel
rows.limitations: Requires NOC connectivity. Used for Dynamics-to-app signaling channel.

rows.nativeApi: App-owned GDPKCS7_* / PKCS#7 signing or verification call sites
rows.dynamicsReplacement: GDCryptoPKCS7 with OpenSSL 3.5.4 flag rules (GDPKCS7_BINARY, GDPKCS7_DETACHED)
rows.limitations: SDK 15.0 OpenSSL 3.x requires every semantically relevant flag at every call site. Detached verify must supply indata.
rows.reportRequirements: Record OpenSSL 3.x flag audit status for each GDPKCS7 call site.

rows.nativeApi: S/MIME Triple-DES encryption under FIPS-enabled Dynamics profile
rows.dynamicsReplacement: AES-128-CBC or AES-256-CBC (FIPS 140-3)
rows.limitations: SDK 15.0 returns an error for Triple-DES S/MIME encryption when FIPS is enabled.

rows.nativeApi: BlackBerry Protect Mobile / SafeBrowsing / SMS URL scan
rows.limitations: Removed as of November 2025 / SDK 15.0. Delete Protect / SafeBrowsing API usage.
rows.reportRequirements: List Protect Mobile / SafeBrowsing surfaces found and removal plan.

rows.nativeApi: SecureStorage cipher posture (AES-CBC legacy activations vs AES-GCM new activations)
rows.dynamicsReplacement: No app API swap — SDK-managed SecureStorage cipher
rows.limitations: SDK 15.0 uses AES-GCM for new activations; existing activations remain AES-CBC.
rows.reportRequirements: Note in report only when customer crypto posture is in scope.
